name.description: Display name; leading and trailing whitespace is removed.

email.description: Sign-in email; trimmed and lowercased. Must not belong to another user (case-insensitive).

avatarUrl.description:
An `/uploads/...` path previously returned by the upload
endpoint. Arbitrary external URLs are rejected. `null`
clears the avatar.

pushOnStory.description: Opt-in push for other members' new stories (push only, off by default).

pushOnGiftList.description: Push for gift lists — being added, the Secret Santa draw, and wishes added by the person you're buying for (push only, on by default).
